note: Structural event flow edits for the gated flow locations of data/flow_locations.json. They run only when the location receives an item other than its vanilla one, after the ordinary parameter edits of that location. $item stands for the chosen item actor. The locations join the pool only with shuffle_rewards=supported and shuffle_rewards_extra on. Design and evidence in docs/flow_checks.md sections 3, 4 and 8, build notes in docs/flow_checks_built_2.md.
